description_expanded: Overview Seas the Day – Stylish 3-Story Escape in Blue Mountain Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: .6 Mile to Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access – Easy stroll or bike ride to sugar-white sands Brand-New 3-Story Home – Fresh, fun, and designed for groups 4 Bedrooms / 4.5 Bathrooms – Space for everyone to spread out Community Pool – Cool off after a beach day Stunning Designer Interiors – Photo-worthy spaces throughout 4 Bikes Included – Cruise Blue Mountain Beach & 30A Top-Floor Loft + Bunks – Perfect for kids & game nights Gas Grill – Ideal for easy dinners at home Covered Garage + Driveway Parking – Up to 3 vehicles Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected while you unwind Welcome to Seas the DayFresh, fun, and three stories of beachy perfection, Seas the Day is a brand-new Blue Mountain Beach retreat made for laid-back coastal living. With four comfortable bedrooms, designer interiors, and plenty of space to relax, this home makes slipping into vacation mode effortless.Inside, enjoy an airy open layout with breezy coastal finishes, a surround sound system, and stylish touches that make every room feel special. The kitchen is fully stocked for everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners, featuring a 6-burner range, KitchenAid appliances, filtered water, and a pod coffee maker to kickstart your mornings.The dining table seats eight—perfect for big breakfasts, board games, or late-night takeout. Just nearby, the primary suite offers dual closets and a spa-like bathroom with double sinks, a walk-in shower, and a soaking tub that practically begs for a bubble bath. A guest room down the hall includes its own private bathroom for extra comfort and privacy.Head upstairs to find a second primary suite with a walk-in shower and double vanity, plus two additional guest rooms that share a spacious bathroom with a separate tub and shower—ideal for smooth, stress-free mornings.The third floor is where the fun happens. A cozy hangout space with a TV is perfect for movies or gaming, along with bunk beds that sleep six (two twin-over-full bunks). Another full bathroom on this level means no waiting in line.Out front, the porch swing is calling your name—perfect for morning coffee, happy hour, or a quiet moment with a good book. Add in complimentary bikes, a nearby community pool, and easy access to local shops and restaurants, and you’ve got the perfect Blue Mountain Beach getaway. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR• Primary Bedroom – Queen bed, private bath, TVSECOND FLOOR• Primary Bedroom – King bed, private bath, TV• Guest Bedroom – Queen bed, shared bath, TV• Guest Bedroom – Queen bed, shared bath, TVTHIRD FLOOR• Loft – 2 twin-over-full bunk beds, private bath, TV AREA ATTRACTIONS:Located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, Seas the Day puts you close to some of 30A’s best spots. Bike to award-winning restaurants, browse charming local shops, or grab a scoop of homemade ice cream nearby. Whether you’re beach-hopping, dining out, or simply relaxing poolside, this laid-back coastal community delivers the perfect mix of fun and relaxation.The SpaceShow less
